rationale: The reconfiguration run left one node at decided 37 while others reached 38 after only 40 convergence rounds, while the default resend_message_tick_timeout is 100 ticks. This successor repeats the same seed and reconfiguration but runs 150 fair-delivery rounds and emits whether all decided indices are equal, testing whether the lag is the expected resend-interval effect rather than a liveness defect. The agreement comparison is retained; a new converged_all comparison (gated on progressed and reconfigured) checks that fair delivery plus the resend timer repairs the lag.

scope.description: Same five-node lossy stress with seed 0xbe5466cf34e90c6c and a reconfigure at action 450, now with run id 11 and 150 fair-delivery convergence rounds before sampling; converged_all reports whether every node's decided index is equal.
assumptions: Fair delivery with ticks on every node drives both repair paths and the documented resend messengers.
The default resend timeout (100 ticks) is the reason a 40-round convergence could leave one follower behind.
No snapshots, trimming or starting the next configuration.
excluded: Starting the next configuration, snapshots, flexible quorums, crash-restart and Byzantine participants.

experiment.prefix: Identical randomized phase to the reconfiguration run (seed 0xbe5466cf34e90c6c, reconfigure at 450, 20 percent loss, appends rejected after the StopSign skipped), with run id 11. After the loop, run up to 150 fair-delivery rounds (deliver everything, tick every node, deliver again), breaking early only when the queue is empty and some node has decided. Emit the safety event with the previous fields plus converged_all computed as all five decided indices equal.

comparisons.description: Bounded convergence: after 150 fair-delivery rounds every node has the same decided index.
Agreement is retained with the longer convergence phase.

experiment.revision_reason: Extends the fair-delivery convergence phase from 40 to 150 rounds so the default 100-tick resend timeout can fire for a lagging follower, and emits converged_all (all decided indices equal) with a comparison requiring it. The lossy phase, seed, reconfigure step and agreement comparison are unchanged.
